text:
anya: Heads-up — small burst of SSE resume retries correlated with the route-shuffle we did in eu at 11:02. Not a full outage but saw clients reattach and a handful of duplicate resume accounting events.

luke: Which change exactly? the shard rebalancer that moves tenant routes between edge pods?

anya: Yes. We shuffled 20% of routes to even load; when a midstream req hit in-flight reassignment the proxy returned 204 and some clients immediately retried and landed on a different shard with a different quota tag. Logged a few traces to #platform-logs.

peter: Console metrics show a tiny blip in "resume_retries" and a matching uptick in billing-dupes. Sampling for resume spans was 0.5% so we only have 2 spans 😕.

eva: Repro locally (super small): open SSE -> trigger route-shuffle -> proxy replies 204 -> client reconnects -> sometimes server records two attaches. Quick script:

```
# repro
curl -N "https://api.redwood/stream?cid=test-01" &
sleep 1
# trigger route shuffle on the console api
curl -XPOST "https://console.internal/api/routes/shuffle?pct=20&region=eu"
sleep 1
kill -HUP $!
sleep 2
```

luke: Immediate mitigations: 1) pause shuffle until we reconcile quota-tags across shards, 2) add a short-term server-side dedupe for resume (window=3s) keyed by sessionid+last_event_id, 3) make shim in proxy to inject X-Resume-Nonce so retries can be deduped upstream. Rollback pause is fastest.

anya: Ops wants a fast config toggle: shuffle.enabled=false for eu-canary. Can we also bump resume sampling to 10% for 4h so SRE can get more traces?

peter: Agreed. Also add a console annotation on the streaming dashboard when route assignments change — right now we have to manually correlate. Product had asked for rollout annotations previously.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Applying cfg-202411: routes.shuffle.eu.enabled=false, tracing.resume_sample=0.10. Rolling to canary hosts (2/2 updated).

eva: After the pause + sample bump we still saw a couple of dup markers but they dropped >95% within 2 min. Dedupe idea sounds good long-term; short-term pause + sampling worked.

luke: For longer term: 1) normalize quota tags at route ingestion so any shard gets the canonical quota_namespace, 2) implement X-Resume-Nonce in proxy and honor it server-side for idempotency (5s ttl), 3) console UX: show per-route "quota_namespace" and an alert badge when a route has non-canonical/legacy tags.

anya: Also a small ops request: add an alert that pages if resume_retries > 10/min AND billing_dupes > 0 within same minute. That correlation is what we missed this time.

peter: I'll file tickets: INF-900 normalize-quota-tags, INF-901 resume-nonce-proxy, INF-902 console-quota-ui, INF-903 auto-sample-after-route-change.

eva: Quick followup: make the resume span sampling increase automatic for 2h after any route-assignment or topology change. We waste time flipping toggles.

luke: Good point. Add to rollout checklist: "boost streaming sampling after topology changes" and annotate dashboard automatically.

anya: Incident note saved: small duplicate-accounting from route-shuffle in eu canary; mitigated by pausing shuffle and increasing resume sampling. No major customer impact but follow-ups required. :thumbsup:
